_about: The final 15 Toggle Link Chain ads (4 Nov 2026), in order of expected CTR, after an independent judge cut 6 of 16 candidates (C03, C06, C09, C10, C13, C16) and added 5 (N01-N05). Lines checked against earlier Naira lines: C11's 'The paper chain grew up.' was too close to COLOUR50 #59 'Art class, all grown up.', so it became 'Craft period, paid off.'; C07's judge line 'Small talk, in gold.' became 'It says hi first.' (the chain is gold tone, so no line says gold). No offer chip on the pictures: Buy 2 / Buy 3 goes in the primary text, fewer words on the image (Diwali 10: the best seller had no words; ads-20 judge: cut the type lines).
price: Rs 1,199 on Shopify, read 4 Nov 2026 (compare-at Rs 2,900); 79 in stock. The live Diwali 04 ad says Rs 1,299: flagged to the owner.

ads.why: India calls paperclips gem clips; the proven turn of 'Paperclip, promoted.' (7.32% on 41 impressions, the best Toggle number) with the Indian noun. Clips at three times a link sell how fine the chain is.
The chain laid as one giant paperclip on cobalt: nothing but the product, on the best static's ground (one gold piece on deep blue, 7.25%).
Being asked about a piece is Naira's highest-CTR moment ('Where is this from?' reel, 11.47%); here a friend's fingers lift the front clasp to look. A staged line, not a customer quote.
Every Indian school had a craft period and a paper chain; the founder kept a paper chain for a chain before (#59).
The chain's one difference shown close up; the click is to see it closer. Story first.

ads.family: graphic: the chain writes a word
ads.why: Jewellery that writes a word stops a scroll; a statement piece starts conversations. Oxblood, so it does not twin 02's cobalt.
Everyone has asked someone to do the hook at the back; worn at the front, she does it herself. Hindi-speaking metros.
The fastest read in a feed; the 'before' is painted out of the 'after' frame so both halves match.
A sibling truth, said while handing the box over to the viewer. Start after 5 Nov, when the Diwali 04 box ad ends.
Every urban working woman takes her ID lanyard off at six; desk to dinner acted out with a real object.

ads.line: One to give. One to keep.
ads.why: Naira's buyer buys for herself and the women around her; Buy 2 for 10% off goes in the primary text. Start after 5 Nov.
'Roz wali chai' is in every ear; tests a Hinglish line. Hindi-speaking metros.
A look-twice picture with no prop; low in the order, the weakest reason to buy.
Two interlocked links are the link icon; the line is the call to action, said dry. The caption carries the size.
The winter look, run in Delhi NCR and the north from mid-November only.

run_notes: Lead every worn ad with the Story (Toggle worn Story 4.38% against Feed 2.15%) and ship a text-free Story beside each.
Kill rule from Diwali 10: pause any ad under 2% CTR after 1,000 impressions; move its budget to the best two.
